newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African prisoner still holding five hostages.
newsitem.headline: S.African prisoner still holding five hostages.

text.p: A prison hostage stand-off stretched into a second day on Tuesday as negotiators failed to persuade one of South Africa's most notorious criminals to free his five hostages and give himself up, an official said.

Thembesile "Tyson" Makaluza, who is serving a 16-year sentence for armed robbery in the St Albans prison near the Indian Ocean city of Port Elizabeth, shot and wounded two warders on Monday before taking five men prisoner.
One of the warders wounded on Monday had managed to escape and alert prison authorities. He was admitted to hospital with bullet wounds in his leg.
The other wounded warder, who was shot in the stomach, was released by Makaluza. Both are in a stable condition.
Makaluza was due to appear in the Port Elizabeth high court later this month on charges which include robbery and 10 counts of murder.
